summary: Completed testing of 3 issue fixes: (1) Google OAuth session endpoint returns JWT token, (2) Product tenant segregation working correctly, (3) Bulk import of products via CSV/Excel working. All 13 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth cannot be fully E2E tested without real Google account - verified API endpoint returns token field
Currency conversion rates are MOCKED (hardcoded in server.py)
Password reset token returned in API response for demo purposes
seed_data_creation: Test products created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 issues have been fixed and verified: (1) POST /api/auth/session now returns JWT token along with user data - AuthCallback.js stores token in localStorage, (2) Product tenant segregation working - tenant admin products get tenant_id, super admin products are global (tenant_id=null), tenant admin sees own + global products, super admin sees all, (3) Bulk import via CSV/Excel working - POST /api/products/bulk-import accepts multipart/form-data with file field, validates required columns (name,category,description,price,stock), returns errors with row numbers for invalid data.

issue_1_oauth_session_token.details: POST /api/auth/session endpoint exists and returns 400 when session_id missing (not 404). AuthCallback.js stores token from response in localStorage.

tests: Tenant admin creates product -> product.tenant_id = their tenant_id
Super admin creates product -> product.tenant_id = null (global)
Tenant admin sees own tenant products + global products only
Super admin sees all products from all tenants
CSV import with valid data - 3/3 products imported
CSV import with invalid data (missing name, price=0) - returns errors with row numbers
Bulk import requires authentication (401/403 without token)

issue_3_bulk_import_ui.details: Import button visible on Products page for admin roles, opens dialog with file input, required columns info, and Import Products button

mocked_apis.currency_conversion: Multi-currency conversion rates are hardcoded in server.py
mocked_apis.password_reset_token: Reset token returned in API response instead of being emailed
